title: Receipt
description: Cryptographically signed receipt proving a completed service session transaction

data.description: Base64-encoded OSPP Canonical Form (spec/06-security.md §4.8) of the canonical ReceiptData body — see receipt-data.schema.json (discriminated oneOf — pass-form {…,offlinePassId,passCounter} or auth-form {…,authId,sessionId}; 12 required fields per form plus meterValues when present; up to 13 signed fields). Signed by the station's ECDSA P-256 private key over the canonical bytes directly (per 06-security.md §6.2; NOT over the base64 form).

signatureAlgorithm.description: Signature algorithm used to sign the receipt

keyId.description: OPTIONAL disambiguation hint identifying the receipt-signing key. Base64url (unpadded) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the signing public key, so both parties derive it from the key alone with no coordination. Deliberately OUTSIDE the signed `data` body: adding it changes no signed field and invalidates no existing signature. HINT ONLY - per 06-security.md §4.3 it MUST NOT select the verification key and MUST NOT widen the candidate set. Emission is OPTIONAL: a station SHOULD emit it once re-provisioned at least once (the only case where the server can hold more than one retained key), and a server MUST NOT require it or reject a receipt for omitting it. The server selects the key from a server-authoritative anchor first, then rejects the receipt if a present keyId disagrees with the selected key.
